text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The first pilot plant in Frauenfeld has shown how well this works.", "gist": "The first pilot plant in Frauenfeld demonstrates successful operation."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Two additional larger pilot plants in Switzerland and Germany will follow in the coming months, after which SeasOn should be able to position itself successfully on the market.", "gist": "Two more large pilot plants in Switzerland and Germany are planned, enabling SeasOn to successfully enter the market."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Renewable energies", "gist": "Renewable energies category"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Agrivoltaics in Buchs", "gist": "Agrivoltaics project located in Buchs"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Plants need sunlight to grow, and solar panels need sunlight to produce electricity.", "gist": "Plants require sunlight to grow; solar panels require sunlight to generate electricity."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Thanks to the agrivoltaic system on the roofs of the new greenhouses at Lubera AG in Buchs (SG), sunlight can be used for both at the same time.", "gist": "An agrivoltaic system on Lubera AG greenhouses in Buchs allows simultaneous use of sunlight for plant growth and electricity production."}]}
